attributes.scope: symbol-adoption pass (work_claim.symbol-adoption.20260831.v1) resolving the 2026-08-30 symaudit exact-gap/spelling candidates for this TU; verified via fnasm+source read+caller context per AGENTS.md symbol-naming procedure, then adopted through the cross-TU rename law and gated with a full ninja build + fndiff spot-check. All 5 renames were internal to this TU (no cross-TU references).

adopted.evidence: Texture-register setup helper (emits a texture-address packet, resets shared texture regs f188/f190/f194/f19c/f1a1/f1a4); called from the same object-update dispatcher as the other 4 renamed functions in this batch (setChrome/setPrimAlpha/setPrimColor/setTexInfo), all texture/draw-register setters. Moderate confidence: positional evidence plus consistent role in the same functional family; no contradicting evidence found.

Builds an object-space texture basis from camera right/up/look vectors via g->scr, i.e. a spherical/environment-mapping (chrome reflection) texgen matrix -- a textbook 'chrome mapping' computation. Strong semantic match.

Sets blend-mode value (obj->m40 = 0x3001D/0x5001D by flag) and z-test compare state (obj->q30 = 0x44/0x48) plus an env-block register pair -- alpha/blend-test register family. Supersedes a stale in-source guess comment ('Xbox candidate: setTexInfo') left by an earlier, less rigorous pass; that name was reassigned during this pass to the function that actually performs texture-bank lookup (see pbSetDODrawRegs below). The stale comment was corrected in the source alongside the rename.

Sets an object's base color/intensity registers (obj->r/g/b from a light-state color table, obj->f48 alpha-ish scalar) selected by flag bits; already carried a matching in-source guess comment ('Xbox candidate: setPrimColor') from an earlier pass, now confirmed and adopted.

Spelling-mismatch candidate, adopted as airtight: body resolves a texture bank/entry from a handle, checks the loaded flag (FatalError on miss), and configures obj->clamp/obj->m50/obj->lmap from texture-entry flags -- i.e. it IS the texture-info resolution routine. Consistent with the naming family already partially adopted in this TU: setLmapInfo (a sibling function immediately below it, comment 'Xbox candidate: setLmapInfo', already real) sets lightmap info; this one sets texture info. No cross-TU references (internal to pb_objregs.c).

value.naming_notes: All 4 exact-gap candidates plus the 1 spelling mismatch were adopted; this TU's batch also surfaced and fixed a stale prior-pass guess comment (see setPrimAlpha evidence).
